name: SunRay Seneca 3-Person Traditional Outdoor Sauna 300D5
description: Description The Sunray Seneca 3-Person Outdoor Contemporary Sauna offers a perfect blend of modern design and traditional sauna wellness. Built with rustic Canadian red cedar and topped with a sleek, maintenance-free metal roof, the Seneca is engineered to handle tough climates while delivering a refined look. Inside, a deep ergonomic bench and spacious layout allow up to three adults to relax comfortably, while the powerful 6kW Harvia heater ensures fast heat-up and consistent performance up to 170°F. Whether sitting with friends or stretching out solo, the Seneca delivers luxury and functionality for your outdoor space. Features Weather-sealed red cedar construction for year-round durability Maintenance-free metal roof withstands harsh weather conditions 6kW Harvia electric heater heats sauna up to 170°F Ergonomic bench seating with backrest for superior comfort Interior and exterior lighting for day or night sessions Dome lighting with auto shut-off for added safety Includes cask and spoon for steam enhancement Hygrometer and sand timer for monitoring heat and session time Easy to assemble and operate 7-year manufacturer’s warranty What's Included? Rustic red cedar sauna cabin with weatherproof finish 6kW Harvia electric heater with sauna rocks Cask and spoon for traditional water pours Hygrometer and sand timer Interior dome lighting with auto shut-off Exterior lighting for nighttime use Specifications Roof Dimensions 78" (W) x 71" (D) Exterior Dimensions (H x W x D) 89" x 61" x 51" Interior Dimensions (H x W x D) 75" x 57" x 47" Power Requirements 220V, 30 amps (dedicated circuit) Certification ETL/CSA Certified – compliant with U.S. and Canadian safety standards Maximum Temperature 170°F Documents D5 Series Assembly Manual
